sources.entry: I, Librarian - Organize PDF papers and office documents. It provides a lot of extra features for students and research groups both in industry and academia. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: I, Librarian is a self-hosted, PHP-based web application for organizing PDF papers and office documents, aimed at students and research groups.
summary.what_it_does: The README is mostly installation instructions and does not describe features in detail; the awesome-selfhosted listing says it offers many extra features for students and research groups in industry and academia. It is served through a web browser, with access from the local computer or an internal network by default. The README mentions migrating an existing library, creating an account, and checking the Administrator > Software details and Administrator > Global settings pages. It mentions optional LibreOffice import for Office files and Tesseract OCR. Installers exist for Windows 10 and a DEB package with a console installer for Ubuntu/Debian. Manual setup uses Apache 2.4+ and PHP 8+.
use_cases: self-hosted reference library for a research group
run a document library on a local network
how_to_run: Windows: download and run the installer (Windows 10), or manually install Apache 2.4+ and PHP 8+, then add the Alias to httpd.conf and unzip the distribution into C:\I, Librarian
Ubuntu/Debian: install using the DEB package or the console installer
Open a browser and visit the local address (127.0.0.1 by default), then create an account or migrate an existing library
notable: Windows installer and DEB package with console installer for Ubuntu/Debian
Optional OCR via Tesseract and Office file import via LibreOffice
Built-in administrator pages for software checks and global settings
Library migration from a previous install
caveats: No Docker or Linux manual install steps are included in the README (headings only), and no Mac OS X installer is available
Default access is restricted to the local computer or internal network; exposing it to the internet requires changing Apache access rules
Manual setup requires Apache and PHP 8+ to be installed and configured
